text:
emma: hey folks, emma here — first week! I can sign into Console but the Feature Flags page shows a lock icon and 'insufficient permissions'. who do I ask for staging flag-manager access? :wave:

zach: welcome! :tada: ping infra-ops for manual group adds. staging access is usually redwood-console-staging-operators or staging-managers depending on the role you need.

emma: I need to toggle a flag for a small e2e test in staging only. don't need prod.

infra-ops: hi @emma, welcome! If it's just toggling in staging we can grant 'flag-manager' scoped to staging for 5 days. Please open the access form (https://internal.redwood.com/access-requests) and include your manager for approval. If you paste your work email here I'll start the manual add to speed things up.

emma: email is emma@redwood.com — filed the form and attached @zach as manager. Any quick CLI tips to avoid 403 after the group is added?

zach: after infra adds the group do a full logout/login and clear site cookies. Sometimes Okta group membership doesn't show until the next SSO token fetch. If ffctl 403s, run `ffctl auth login` to refresh local token.

infra-ops: manual ticket ACC-7001 opened. Grant in progress. ETA ~10m.

devex-bot: onboarding docs updated with example snippets: https://docs.redwood.com/onboarding/console-ff. Quick snippet you can add to your notes:

```
# get a short-lived token using SA in Vault
vault read -field=value secret/onboarding/sa/emma-ffcli > /tmp/sa.json
ffctl auth login --service-account=/tmp/sa.json
ffctl flags list --env=staging
ffctl flags set --env=staging my_flag=true --comment "test from emma"
```
infra-ops: manual grant completed by infra-ops. Group added: redwood-console-staging-operators.

emma: can confirm I can see Manage toggles now. thanks! One more Q: where do temporary SA keys get stored and how long do they last?

infra-ops: we place them in Vault under secret/onboarding/sa/<name> and grant read for 7 days. Use `vault renew` to extend or re-request via access form. For CI jobs ask for CI-scoped SA with longer TTL and an approval workflow.

emma: perfect, I'll add a tiny how-to to the onboarding docs and tag @devex for review. thanks all :pray:
